events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at Cincinnati Reds

headlines.description: — Cincinnati's Dane Myers dropped a fly ball with two outs in the ninth, opening the flood gates in a six-run inning to give the St. Louis Cardinals a 10-9 win over the Reds.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dane Myers' dropped fly with 2 outs in 9th gives Cardinals a wild 10-9 win over Reds

events.name: San Francisco Giants at Cleveland Guardians

headlines.description: — Gavin Williams struck out 11 over 5 2/3 innings, José Ramírez had an RBI single in the three-run first and the Cleveland Guardians beat the San Francisco Giants 5-2 for their first home series victory in seven weeks on Thursday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gavin Williams strikes out 11 as Guardians beat Giants 5-2

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at Tampa Bay Rays

headlines.description: — Kazuma Okamoto, Nathan Lukes and Daz Cameron homered, George Springer drove in two runs and Shane Bieber pitched seven strong innings and the Toronto Blue Jays beat the Tampa Bay Rays 5-1 Thursday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Blue Jays hit 3 homers to power past Rays 5-1

events.name: Athletics Athletics at Kansas City Royals

headlines.description: — Bobby Witt Jr. homered and scored three runs, and the Kansas City Royals beat the Athletics 6-2 on Thursday for their first four-game sweep of the season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Witt homers as the Royals earn their fifth straight win with a four-game sweep of the Athletics

headlines.description: — Garrett Mitchell and Gary Sánchez each hit two-run doubles during a six-run first inning, and the MLB-best Milwaukee Brewers beat the Seattle Mariners 7-4 on Thursday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Garrett Mitchell and Gary Sánchez help Brewers score 6 in 1st inning and beat Mariners 7-4

events.name: Atlanta Braves at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Grant Holmes took a no-hitter into the seventh inning, Austin Riley doubled and singled to drive in Atlanta's runs, and the Braves topped the Chicago White Sox 2-0 on Thursday to end a three-game slide.
headlines.shortLinkText: Grant Holmes takes no-hitter into 7th and Riley has 2 RBIs as the Braves top the White Sox 2-0

events.name: New York Yankees at Baltimore Orioles

headlines.description: — Gerrit Cole pitched six sharp innings, Luis García Jr. and Spencer Jones homered and the New York Yankees completed a three-game sweep in Baltimore with a 6-1 victory over the Orioles on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: No debating this win: Yankees complete a 3-game sweep with a 6-1 rout of the Orioles

headlines.description: — Jacob deGrom struck out 10 and allowed one hit and one walk in six innings while reaching 2,000 career strikeouts in the second-fewest games and innings in major league history as the Texas Rangers beat the Washington Nationals 2-0 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rangers' Jacob deGrom surpasses 2,000 K's and combines with 3 on 1-hitter in 2-0 win over Nationals

events.name: Los Angeles Angels at Houston Astros

headlines.description: — Zach Neto was 5-for-6 with his 21st homer and a career-high seven RBI and the Los Angeles Angels scored their most runs in three years to rout the Houston Astros 18-3 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Neto homers in 5-hit, 7-RBI night to help the Angels rout the Astros 18-3
